headline: 9 killed in head-on bus collision in Sylhet
summary: At least 25 people were injured in a violent crash between two passenger buses in Osmani Nagar, Sylhet.
details: A head-on collision between two passenger buses in Osmani Nagar, Sylhet, has left at least 9 people dead and 25 others injured.
The accident occurred during the morning hours, causing significant casualties among the passengers.
Emergency services rushed to the scene to rescue those trapped in the wreckage of the two vehicles.
The injured were transported to the nearest medical facilities, including Sylhet MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital for treatment.
Local authorities are investigating the cause of the crash to determine how the two buses collided head-on.
caption:
9 dead, 25 injured. A horrific head-on bus collision in Sylhet has left families devastated.

A head-on collision between two passenger buses in Osmani Nagar, Sylhet, has left at least 9 people dead and 25 others injured.

The accident occurred during the morning hours, causing significant casualties among the passengers.

Emergency services rushed to the scene to rescue those trapped in the wreckage of the two vehicles.

The injured were transported to the nearest medical facilities, including Sylhet MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital for treatment.

Local authorities are investigating the cause of the crash to determine how the two buses collided head-on.

headline_marked: 7 labourers [[killed as speeding bus ploughs into workers]] in Bogura
headline: 7 labourers killed as speeding bus ploughs into workers in Bogura
summary: A speeding bus lost control and crashed into a group of workers in Bogura, leaving seven dead and several others injured.
details: A speeding bus lost control and ploughed into a group of labourers in Bogura, killing seven people on the spot.
The victims were workers who were reportedly working on the road or nearby, and several others were injured in the crash.
Following the accident, local residents and onlookers gathered at the scene, leading to a temporary blockade of the road.
The blockade was reportedly lifted after authorities promised to construct speed breakers to prevent future accidents at that location.
Emergency services and local authorities responded to the scene to manage the crowd and the casualties.
The incident highlights ongoing concerns regarding speeding and road safety for workers on national highways.
caption:
7 workers killed instantly as a speeding bus loses control in Bogura.

A speeding bus lost control and ploughed into a group of labourers in Bogura, killing seven people on the spot.

The victims were workers who were reportedly working on the road or nearby, and several others were injured in the crash.

Following the accident, local residents and onlookers gathered at the scene, leading to a temporary blockade of the road.

The blockade was reportedly lifted after authorities promised to construct speed breakers to prevent future accidents at that location.

Emergency services and local authorities responded to the scene to manage the crowd and the casualties.

The incident highlights ongoing concerns regarding speeding and road safety for workers on national highways.
